features.name: py-guard pip-audit runs; agent-hook checks Codex move targets
features.description: Found by the feat-105 subagent check 2026-10-23. templates/hooks/python/py-guard.sh passes -q to pip-audit, which 2.10.1 rejects (exit 2), so every run with a requirements.txt reports vulnerable deps and blocks: atelier is affected. templates/hooks/common/agent-hook.sh splits a Codex apply_patch per file but skips '*** Move to:' lines, so a broken file renamed in the patch is not checked. Fix both in the template and atelier's (and hangar's) copies.
acceptance_criteria: py-guard runs pip-audit without an unknown flag and blocks only on real findings
a Codex patch moving a broken .sh to a new name is checked and blocked through agent-hook.sh
atelier and hangar copies match the templates outside their config block
features.evidence: Tests first: the Move-to case (test_agent_hook.sh) and a pip-audit stub that rejects -q like 2.10.1 failed on the old templates; 14 and 54 pass after. py-guard now runs pip-audit with --progress-spinner off and blocks only when the output names known vulnerabilities; a run that cannot audit (offline, unresolvable pin) prints SKIP with pip's ERROR line. Real pip-audit 2.10.1: certifi==2026.7.22 gives PYSEC-2026-4320 and exit 1, 2026.10.19 exit 0. agent-hook.sh also passes '*** Move to:' targets to the wrapped hook. Reviews: two subagents (correctness, security), no confirmed defects; they disagreed on blocking when pip-audit fails (fail-closed vs findings only), resolved for the acceptance wording, findings only, and re-reviewed: no confirmed defects. Trade-off kept: one unresolvable pin turns the audit into a visible SKIP for that app. atelier and hangar copies synced after this commit.

features.name: target repos pull harness updates; sync-all writes no tracked files
features.description: Found 2026-10-24: sessions here committed synced hooks inside hangar/atelier main checkouts while their sessions and jobs worked there (10-23 collision; 10-24 ahead 1/behind 1). sync-all keeps only the host-local pack links (ignored via .git/info/exclude); hooks, wiring and the version stamp are no longer written by update.sh or the weekly job. New `harness_adapter.py sync --dry-run <repo>` lists what sync would change, on the same code path as sync. Preflight shows it ('harness behind: N files; run sync here and commit'); the weekly job reports 'behind by N' instead of syncing and alerting on a dirty tree. Replaces hangar's request to commit and push from a throwaway worktree (hangar PROGRESS 'In flight', docs/sessions.md).
acceptance_criteria: update.sh/sync-all leaves a target repo's git status clean (only excluded pack links change)
sync --dry-run lists the same changes sync makes, and writes nothing (fixture test)
preflight in a target that is behind prints the file count and the sync command
the weekly report shows 'behind by N' and no longer flags uncommitted files after a sync
features.evidence: sync-all only links packs and reports 'behind by N files' (test: git status clean after sync_all); sync --dry-run shares sync's code path and writes nothing (test compares with a real sync); preflight shows the count and the sync command, matching only the adapter's exact line; weekly reports 'harness behind by N' instead of uncommitted files and drifted hooks. Reviews (2+2+1 subagents) found: sync writing outside the repo through committed symlinks (.claude, .codex, .agents, hook copies, skills dirs, agent-harness.json) or into .git (any spelling: checked by file identity), repo text passing for status, hidden refusal reason, duplicate template names; all fixed test-first. 78 + 32 tests, 11 gates OK; hangar and atelier dry-run: up to date.

features.name: outside-agent investigation profile and tool permission resilience
features.description: Outside subagents running non-interactively across claude-kiro, codex-kiro, agy, claude, and codex hit tool permission denials or unhandled halts during investigations and code reviews. Add an 'investigate' purpose profile with least-privilege network and tool access, expand agy review inspection commands, allow multi-candidate cascade fallback on candidate errors, and bypass read-only scans during investigation.
acceptance_criteria: outside-agent.sh run supports --purpose investigate with full inspection tools and network access
claude-kiro uses safe tool allowlisting without triggering classifier billing 402/hangs
codex-kiro and codex use danger-full-access for investigate and read-only for review
agy review allowlist supports find, which, stat, file, and 2>&1 redirections
candidate errors in a multi-candidate chain cascade to subsequent candidates instead of stopping immediately
unit tests verify all profiles, allowlist rules, and fallback cascades
features.evidence: Added '--purpose investigate' profile supporting unprompted network & inspection access; claude-kiro uses safe tool allowlisting for review ('Bash(git *),Bash(cat *),Bash(grep *),Read,Glob,Grep') and investigate ('Bash,Read,Glob,Grep') avoiding auto-mode 402 errors; codex-kiro uses '-s danger-full-access' for investigate and '-s read-only' for review; agy review allowlist expanded to include find, which, stat, file, and 2>&1; candidate tool denials cascade to subsequent candidates; secret-scan skips for both review and investigate. 213 unit tests passed, all 11 harness gates passed.

features.name: outside-agent run picks agy's model and effort
features.description: Owner request 2026-10-30: raise outside agents on Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon, Opus 5.5 or GPT through agy. agy 1.4.11 serves gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-4-argon, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5 (low/medium/high) and gpt-oss-120b (medium); --effort must match a suffixed name. `outside-agent.sh run` had no way to choose: review pinned gemini-4-argon-high, delegate took agy's default, and every agy row was logged as family gemini.
acceptance_criteria: run --model <name> [--effort <level>] passes them to agy for review and delegate, and tries agy only
--effort without --model, a name outside [a-z0-9.-], or --model with no agy in the conf exits 2 without running an agent
the run log names the model and the family it implies (claude-, gpt-, gemini-)
features.evidence: scripts/outside_agent.py: run --model (MODEL_RE [a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,63}) and --effort (low..max, needs --model); with --model the conf narrows to agy (exit 2 if absent); review keeps the allowlist path (no skip-permissions, note prepended), delegate adds the model after its permission flags; --effort passed only when given, as agy rejects a level that differs from the name's. Attempt and run rows carry model and model_family (claude-/gpt-/gemini-, else unknown); stderr says used=agy model=X. Tests first: 22 new cases failed, 227 pass after; mypy clean. Live: review via claude-opus-5-5 --effort medium answered (logged family claude); gemini-4-argon-low --effort high exited 2. Found while testing: agy delegates in this repo time out because agy runs the repo's Stop hook gates (~100 s) after answering (PROGRESS Blockers). Reviews: two subagents (correctness, security): no confirmed defects. README documents --model. Follow-up 2026-10-30: an outside Flash-high review ended on a refused grep -rn "a\|b" (4 of 19 agy reviews ended on a refused command), so AGY_REVIEW_NOTE now says to search with grep -e a -e b; a test checks that form passes the allowlist and the refused one does not.
